description: CLI-neutral write policy for the guard foundation. Generators render it per launcher (Seatbelt, bubblewrap/Landlock) and per CLI adapter (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini). Anchors are PARAMETERS supplied at render time; this file names no machine path.

anchors.repo: root of the checkout the profile is rendered for (trestle mirror, worktree, or primary)
anchors.config_dir: the CLI's per-terminal config dir (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR for Claude Code); its memory/ subtree stays writable
anchors.worktrees: the directory holding sibling lane worktrees for this repo
anchors.tmp: every temp root the launcher grants (TMPDIR, the per-user temp tree, the session scratchpad)
anchors.vault: the operator's handover vault (sweep/wrapup pairs); absent on a machine with none, and then its rows render nothing

phases.reason: a fresh fork has no guard yet: /clean-instantiate resets VERSION and ecosystem.json, /ecosystem-init writes the fork's own ecosystem.json, and the launcher applies the profile afterwards. No broker route accepts bytes from inside the sandbox; from then on only land-lane writes these files
